deepseek.peakHours: Weekdays 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, excluding Chinese public holidays. Archive requests are all outside those hours.

scope: 153 replies in nine final-v5 arms only. Uses provider-reported usage and archived DSH timestamps, including reply maintenance and initial priming. List-price estimates, not account invoices. Excludes prior development runs, UI runs, infrastructure, storage, credits, tax, and unmeasured future idle maintenance. Peak and repeated-mix projections hold token/cache usage fixed; not long-session forecasts.
mainAccounting: DSH inputTokens is the cache-miss bucket; cacheReadTokens is disjoint. No separate cache-write usage. Thinking disabled; no extra reasoning charge is added. JEV reports input/output only and public pricing makes output free.
